messages:
Marina Chen: Heads-up: cert-manager webhook cert rotation scheduled for tomorrow 02:00 UTC. Need to confirm etcd minor upgrade window for zero-downtime and whether RBAC tweak is required for the webhook's SA.
Sandeep Rao: @Marina we can do etcd v3.5.12 -> v3.5.14 in same window. main risk is webhook pod restarts losing leader lock. Plan: drain webhook, rotate cert, ensure webhook re-registers. No cluster-wide RBAC changes expected.
Nikita Patel: What about audit logs and KMS? We'll need to ensure KMS key access when webhooks call external KMS for cert retrieval. Also audit log config might reject requests during short window.
Alex Gomez: Agree re KMS. Confirmed with sec that webhooks run as `system:serviceaccount:webhook:webhook-sa`. We've granted kms:Decrypt to that SA via KMS proxy. But rotation will use new key version — should be transparent.
infra-bot: Staging job scheduled: `job/2001234567-cert-rotation-staging` started. Logs: https://ci.redwood.local/job/2001234567
Marina Chen: Can we run a small preflight in staging:
```
kubectl -n webhook get validatingwebhookconfiguration
kubectl -n webhook describe secret webhook-tls
kubectl -n webhook rollout status deploy/webhook
```
I'll run them and paste outputs.
Sandeep Rao: Also need to update RBAC binding during rollout for the short window when old SA token is invalidated. Quick patch to `ClusterRoleBinding webhook-kms-access` to include `system:serviceaccount:webhook:webhook-sa` — already in infra repo (PR #894).
Nikita Patel: :thumbsup: I'll watch audit stream and set a grep for `validation failure` and `etcdserver` errors. If we see >5 validation failures in 1m, rollback.
Alex Gomez: Oncall FYI: if anything breaks, fallback is to reapply old cert (stored in s3://redwood-backups/webhook-certs/) and pause etcd upgrade. @oncall
oncall: Got it. I'll be on standby 01:30–04:00 UTC. Slack ping channel #incidents if we need escalation.
